def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    dist = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for c in route:
            s += demands[c]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = dist[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += dist[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        c += dist[route[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def reverse_route(route):
        route.reverse()

    # Start with singleton feasible routes.
    routes = [[c] for c in customers]
    loads = [demands[c] for c in customers]

    # Clarke-Wright savings merge on route ends.
    savings = []
    n = len(customers)
    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = dist[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + dist[depot][j] - dist[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    customer_to_route = {}
    for idx, r in enumerate(routes):
        customer_to_route[r[0]] = idx

    active = [True] * len(routes)

    for _, i, j in savings:
        ri = customer_to_route.get(i, -1)
        rj = customer_to_route.get(j, -1)
        if ri == -1 or rj == -1 or ri == rj:
            continue
        if not active[ri] or not active[rj]:
            continue

        A = routes[ri]
        B = routes[rj]
        if loads[ri] + loads[rj] > capacity:
            continue

        merged = None
        # Four endpoint orientations.
        if A[-1] == i and B[0] == j:
            merged = A + B
        elif A[0] == i and B[-1] == j:
            merged = B + A
        elif A[0] == i and B[0] == j:
            merged = A[::-1] + B
        elif A[-1] == i and B[-1] == j:
            merged = A + B[::-1]

        if merged is None:
            continue

        routes[ri] = merged
        loads[ri] += loads[rj]
        active[rj] = False
        for c in merged:
            customer_to_route[c] = ri

    routes = [routes[i] for i in range(len(routes)) if active[i]]
    loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

    # Deterministic relocate repair / improvement.
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        for r_idx in range(len(routes)):
            if r_idx >= len(routes):
                break
            route = routes[r_idx]
            if not route:
                continue
            base_cost = route_cost(route)

            best_move = None
            best_delta = 0

            for pos, node in enumerate(route):
                before = depot if pos == 0 else route[pos - 1]
                after = depot if pos == len(route) - 1 else route[pos + 1]
                remove_delta = dist[before][after] - dist[before][node] - dist[node][after]

                for t_idx in range(len(routes)):
                    if t_idx == r_idx:
                        continue
                    if loads[t_idx] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    trg = routes[t_idx]
                    for ins in range(len(trg) + 1):
                        left = depot if ins == 0 else trg[ins - 1]
                        right = depot if ins == len(trg) else trg[ins]
                        insert_delta = dist[left][node] + dist[node][right] - dist[left][right]
                        delta = remove_delta + insert_delta
                        if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (t_idx, ins, pos, node) < (best_move[0], best_move[1], best_move[2], best_move[3]) if best_move else True):
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_move = (t_idx, ins, pos, node)

            if best_move and best_delta < 0:
                t_idx, ins, pos, node = best_move
                route = routes[r_idx]
                route.pop(pos)
                loads[r_idx] -= demands[node]
                if t_idx > r_idx:
                    t_idx -= 1
                routes[t_idx].insert(ins, node)
                loads[t_idx] += demands[node]
                if not route:
                    routes.pop(r_idx)
                    loads.pop(r_idx)
                improved = True
                break

    # Local 2-opt within each route.
    for idx in range(len(routes)):
        route = routes[idx]
        if len(route) < 3:
            continue
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            best_gain = 0
            best_i = -1
            best_j = -1
            m = len(route)
            for i in range(m - 1):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, m):
                    c = route[j]
                    d = depot if j == m - 1 else route[j + 1]
                    gain = (dist[a][b] + dist[c][d]) - (dist[a][c] + dist[b][d])
                    if gain > best_gain:
                        best_gain = gain
                        best_i = i
                        best_j = j
            if best_gain > 0:
                route[best_i:best_j + 1] = route[best_i:best_j + 1][::-1]
                changed = True

    return routes
